==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
* Starting from upgrade 8, Guts becomes hybrid and can hit air enemies
* {{PAGENAME}} bleed damage is 25% of his damage (when paired with Bloodcry (Fallen) or Blood (Unleashed) his bleed does 125% of his total damage)
* At base max upgrade, the combined damage per second ( DPS ) with his bleed is '''28,375.25''' (Stats may vary)
* {{PAGENAME}} "Dragonslayer Assault" attack has the fourth highest multi-hit count in the entire game, only being topped by [[Boxer]] and [[Mimic Sorcerer (Cursed Child)]] at 7 Hits and Ghost-kun (Bound) at 9 Hits!
* On Guts "Beast of Darkness" attack, bleed is applied on the second hit rather than the first. This is mainly due to the fact that {{PAGENAME}} is missing one of his eyes and can not properly aim.
